mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may increase tretinoin's teratogenic risk and GI irritation while tretinoin increases photosensitivity and skin irritation risk; both drugs have hepatic metabolism potential for minor competition.
action: Monitor for increased GI side effects and skin irritation; use lowest effective NSAID dose; ensure adequate sun protection with tretinoin; counsel on teratogenicity risk in reproductive-age patients.
